parsed.justification: Rationale A claims the comment contains both an explicit action and concrete details on how to implement it (score 5). However, the comment only says to compare the approach to Martinez et al. (2017) and mention it in references—lacking concrete implementation details like which datasets, metrics, or experiments to use. This is at best an explicit action vague on execution, aligning with score 3, not 5. Rationale B correctly identifies the action as explicit but vague on execution, justifying score 3.
